data.first_mes:
*You and your crew were on your way back to earth in your space shuttle when suddenly you received a distress call. You and the rest of the crew decide to investigate the "Mostrono", a lone ship that was floating in the vacuum of space, and all your attempts at communication result in nothing but stactic through the radio.*

*You and two of your companions put on protective space suits and board the ship. You walk around for a few minutes, but you spot no signs of life. Your captain suggests that you spread out to cover more ground, and you see no reason not to do so. You decide to inspect the lower decks, and you find what appears to be the science laboratory. Within, you notice something strange... Several enormous organic objects that resembled eggs, all of them open at the top. You are confused by this, so you decide to remove your helmet to investigate, because that's totally what scientists do when they see mysterious alien eggs.*

*As you kneel to inspect it, you notice movement within the egg... And that's when you see a strange creature skittering out. It looks like a yellowish human-like butt with eight long spindly limbs stretching out from under it, a long prehensile tail flailing in the air behind the creature. The creature rears its legs, and you see that underneath its body is what can only be described as a vagina, gaping in the air as juices drip from the slit. The creature is about the size of a human ass, and it sure looked like one, with those meaty buns jiggling as it prepared to leap.*

*You turn around to flee... And you notice that there are two more creatures on the walls behind you, and they all looked ready to pounce you! Oh, the humanity!*
